notes: TMax-15K is overwhelmingly the strongest pool: it holds a dense cluster of weak-cipher key-recovery tasks including two explicit differential-cryptanalysis-recovers-a-16-bit-key tasks (task_004544_3403e2f6, task_004532_51ae89be) that are near-perfect matches, plus a chosen-plaintext oracle attack (task_002392_b43fd016). The honest best 10 are 8 TMax + 2 TerminalWorld (CTF cipher break, timing oracle attack). Note task_004544 and task_004051 wrap the cryptanalysis inside a larger video/forensics chore, but the crypto core is exactly on point. TerminalWorld and RTS otherwise offer mostly applied crypto (GPG/RSA/DH/OTP) and JWT algorithm-confusion attacks (real key-recovery, ranked highest in those pools). SWE-Smith has no cipher-break tasks; its 10 are chosen for the adjacent skills that genuinely transfer - signature/MAC and CRC correctness, ASN.1 bit-level encoding, Hamming/XOR-difference counting, seed-driven determinism, and keyspace-search (binary search) logic. SWE-Rebench is the weakest: borgbackup's S-box/xor-seed rolling hash and a KMS sign/verify bug are the only genuinely relevant items; the pyca cryptography and KMS entries share the domain but exercise none of the attack skill, so they score 2.
